name: dental-website-doctor
description: Assess a dental practice’s public website and Google presence with evidence, prioritized fixes and proposed content.

interface.shortDescription: Assess a dental practice’s online presence
interface.longDescription: Review patient journeys, public Google listing evidence, mobile and technical checks, and three content drafts. Findings include source URLs, test conditions and limitations. Private Google checks require owner authorization; inaccessible fields are not treated as missing.
defaultPrompt: Show me a fictional example assessment.
Explain the highest-priority findings in this assessment.
